title: Medpace Holdings
summary: US clinical-research organisation focused on small and mid-sized biotech sponsors.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

Medpace runs clinical trials for biotech and small pharma, with a focus on oncology, cardiology and metabolic disease. Its customer base is more biotech-heavy than large CROs, making it sensitive to funding conditions. Backlog and cancellations are the key operating metrics.

Technology Exposure

  • Clinical trial management
  • Oncology and metabolic trials
  • Regulatory support

What To Watch

  • Biotech funding
  • Backlog conversion
  • Cancellations

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
